question: Which of the following is the most reactive metal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The Reactivity series of metals refers to the arrangement of metals in the descending order of their reactivities.

 
• ​Features of Reactivity series:

 
 
• The metals at the top of the reactivity series are powerful reducing agents since they are easily oxidized and get corroded
